data.one_liner: Play Vimeo videos in Flutter using an InAppWebView.
data.what_it_does: This package renders a Vimeo video inside a Flutter widget via InAppWebView. It exposes many playback options and callbacks for events such as play, pause, finish, and errors.
use_when: You need to embed a Vimeo video in a Flutter app
You want customizable playback controls and event callbacks
You require web, iOS, Android, macOS, or Windows support
avoid_when: You need native video playback without a webview
You are building a platform that does not support WebView
strengths: Easy to integrate with a single widget
Supports many playback options and callbacks
Works across mobile, web, and desktop
weaknesses: Relies on WebView, so performance may be lower than native players
No support for other video platforms
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package. No special permissions or build_runner needed.
